Portfolio.Headline: Software Developer · AI & Backend Development
Portfolio.Bio: I graduated from UMSL in May 2026 with a B.S. in Computer Science and a minor in Psychology. Most recently I was an Artificial Intelligence Intern at BlueScope Buildings North America, turning an Azure-based RAG tool into a reusable application for indexing and answering questions about codebases. I like building across the stack: backend APIs in Java and C#, systems programming in C and C++, web apps in React, and games in Unity. Below are projects from my coursework and my own time.

Education.Details: Completed six cross-campus courses covering AI/ML and LLM fundamentals, unsupervised learning, cloud AI application development, NLP, and deep learning.

Resume.Summary: Computer Science graduate with AI development internship experience and projects in Java REST APIs, Python data pipelines, and C/C++ systems programming. Experienced with authentication, relational databases, process coordination, and debugging on Linux.

Highlights: What you built or improved, and the result.

Experience.Title: Artificial Intelligence Intern
Highlights: Refactored an existing Azure-based RAG tool into a standalone application for ingesting and indexing different codebases, replacing repository-specific logic with reusable configuration.
Used Cursor to restructure hardcoded pipeline components while retaining Azure-generated embeddings and Azure AI Search retrieval for codebase question answering.
Validated the generalized application across several codebases, manually checking answers for correctness and grounding in the underlying source code.

CS-4760-Assignment-6-Memory-Management-w.Title: Memory Management Simulator
CS-4760-Assignment-6-Memory-Management-w.Description: Controller and worker processes using fork/exec, System V shared memory, and message queues to exchange simulated memory read/write requests. Implements a 256-entry frame table, 32-page process tables, LRU frame selection, dirty-bit tracking, and simulated disk-I/O timing with memory-layout logging.

P2-Parser-and-Parse-Tree-Builder.Title: Compiler Front End
P2-Parser-and-Parse-Tree-Builder.Description: A lexical scanner and recursive-descent parser for a custom language, with tokenization, parse-tree construction, and syntax-error reporting in modular components.

bbna-hackmw26.Title: Closure Call
bbna-hackmw26.Description: Weather-driven facility closure decisions, built at Hack Midwest 2026. Pulls live National Weather Service data, uses a team of AI agents (Strands Agents SDK on Amazon Bedrock) to recommend an operating posture with its reasoning, drafts the employee notifications, and keeps a tamper-evident decision record.
